Known Date collects a date the user already knows — a birthday, a passport issue date, an expiration — through three separate fields for day, month, and year. It follows the [UK Government Design System date input pattern](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/date-input/): a labeled ` ` wraps three plain ` ` elements, the user types each part themselves, and the host submits a single canonical ISO date.

The markdown component turns raw markdown into rendered HTML using the [Marked](https://marked.js.org/) library. Indentation is handled automatically. You can nest your markdown at any depth to match the surrounding HTML structure and the common leading whitespace will be stripped before parsing.
